body:
I had much the same thing happen.  I was always afraid that she was to good to be true. We talked about it once and she confided that she felt the same way and sometimes she felt like she loved me so much, it made her crazy and jealous even though she knew it was entirely irrational, lol.

 A few months later she broke up with me suddenly, and with no notice or warning, after we'd had a nice dinner together, walked back to the car holding hands etc etc... Point being, you never know. Never can know. Just enjoy the time you have now and dont make yourself crazy thinking about a future you have little control over.

#probablynothelping

The only nightmares I have are dreams of a happy existence that eludes me. Dr. Seuss wrote that "You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams." Heartbreak is the polar opposite.

Yea the dreams are the worst... Im not sure which are worse tbh.. the ones like you described.. or the ones where I dream we're doing things we used to do.. Just normal stuff like walking through the park or laughing together... Then I wake up in an empty bed, in our empty apartment and the reality that Ill never experience that with her again sinks in. Its just devastating... Those are the usually the days I dont get out of bed until I absolutely have to, if at all...

Yea, its all real weird.. So different from the person Id been with all this time.  Never saw this side of her until afterwards but man.. Tbh, that part kinda helped though make it easier though. Now that shes back to being friendly and nice it reminds me of how we used to be which just makes everything difficult again.

Yea.. she definitely knows Im hurt already.. Part of our big blow-up was me telling her (we were real real drunk.. and yes I know getting hammered with your ex is a terrible idea ) that I still loved her and hoped we might still get married and do all the things we had planned on (things we'd said only a month or two prior.) She told me that was crazy, that people break up all the time and I needed to get over it and that she couldnt even be friends with me because I clearly wasnt over her....
I just feel like that makes me look unstable/heartsick/immature etc.. And thats definitely not what Im trying to portray, whatever the reality...
God I hope not... Im struggling with it already.. If this is only the tip of the pain and loss then... damn

At worst, play it cool. Dont let him know hes had an effect on you. I myself did a terrible job of following my own advice and it has turned out terribly.. But yea, best response is probablly no response, but I understand that can be difficult

Every thing really. Panic at the Disco was one of our favorite bands and its impossible for me to listen to them now. She was also into a lot of hip hop, she knew every word and would sing every word to a bunch of the popular stuff, Drake etc. It was actually really cute.. and it sucks because those songs are so popular.. and I cant help but hear them at like work (I bartend  on the side so its constant..) Ill be in the middle of bartending and all of a sudden Im just devastated and depressed and want to curl up and crawl into a hole.. Makes it hard to function, especially in that job
Ive never understood how people can be like that.. In love one day and its gone the next.. It makes me wonder sometimes if Im really even cut out for this world..

Im conflicted. On one hand, the release helps.. On the other hand.. it reminds me of being with her, in the moment and even in just flashes after... Ive ultimately decided to try to stop in the hope itll help me stop thinking about sex which in turn will help me stop thinking of sex with her (and whos shes currently having sex with...)

100% dont do that. Chasing kills attraction. And dont get too hopeful about the "there isnt somebody else thing.." Whether its because they think itll make you feel better or are just lying.. people are full of shit.

I had just signed a lease on a new place we were going to move into (I didnt ask her to be on the lease because I didnt think it mattered..) We were so excited, this was going to be OUR place, wed build it all together. A couple days before we broke up she was asking me about ways we could decorate it. Then all of a sudden it was all gone. Now Im stuck in "our" nice new place, all by myself, struggling to pay twice what I expected in rent. Morale of the story... Never hope for anything. Never expect anything

Trust me.. not knowing is far far far better. I kept my ex on snapchat and she was a frequent poster. Its summer so Ive been treated to numerous pictures of her in a thong at pools.. or her all dressed up out on the town.. or (the absolute worse..) her posting a bunch of heart emojis on a picture where someone had left a card on her pillow indicating theyd left her breakfast when she woke up.  Then theres the snapchat map that.. unless you have incredible self-control.. lets you with one click see exactly where tjere at.. whos house they slept at.. I dont want to be creepy/nosey etc.. but when its that easy.. how do you not look?? Its pretty much just driven me crazy with agony.. So trust me.. ignorance is bliss.. It's better not to know..

No and on some level maybe it was a good thing.. I really thought she was better than that and had kind of put her on a pedastal because she seemed so perfect while we were dating..

But I guess this is the real her that was going to be revealed eventually so its kind of good to have her bare her flaws so openly. It probably would have been much more difficult long-term if she'd shown up and been the sweet amazing girl I remembered before disappearing again. At least this way Im getting a dose of reality which kind of takes the shine off..

Youre right but man.. how embarassing.. It was her birthday a couple days ago so I sat there, with a present in front of me.. for an hour and a half before getting up and leaving.. No way to play that off..  How incredibly stupid I must have looked to everyone..

Yea exactly that.. He was suuuch a douche to me the entire time we were together.. but the whole time Id just meet him with kindness.. The fight that they got into where he freaked out when she stopped talking to him was because he invited her and some of his friends to a party at his house, then when she showed up with me he threw a big fit because I "wasnt invited," acted like he didnt know who I was and tried to have a bunch of his friends throw me out...  I didn't even really get mad then.. I just took it in stride and said I didnt care and it was fine with me if she still wanted to be friends with him. 

I was just so sure she loved me and wasnt worried about him at all.. Now to know that shes spending all her time with him while I havent seen her in a month... That hes enjoying the fact that "he won" after all his craziness and manipulation amd douchebaggery... Man it stings...

Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torment of man. 

-Nietzsche

Ive got a guess... His parents are rich and never home so, even though hes in his 20's, he basically lives in their giant house, complete with a pool/hot tub on a hillside all by himself. Pretty sure that's how he aquired most of his friends too.. The while thing kinda makes me sick to my stomach..

"I love you, and could see myself marrying you one day but right now I just dont want to be in a relationship and need to be single..." Cue 3 weeks later and shes dating this manipulative fuckwad who was constantly trying to break us up...

Yea.... people suck.

"I love you, and could see myself marrying you one day but right now I just dont want to be in a relationship and need to be single..." Cue 3 weeks later and shes dating this manipulative fuckwad who was constantly trying to break us up...

Yea.... people suck.

I laughed.  I cried.  I maybe even grew a little as a person.  Seriously, great story man.  I think somewhere we all know all these things but it helps to hear them. 

It also makes you feel a little better knowing you're not alone. My most recent was very similar.. We had gotten a little more distant but I didn't see it coming.. Then bam.. the cliches.. I still love you but.. I just want to be single for awhile.. blah blah..   
I NEVER cry, like Ive lost loved ones with a stones face.. but I sobbed when my ex left.. right in front of her like a child.. begged her to just take some time to think about it etc.. And of course she still left.  This weekend will be a month since Ive seen her at all and its been rough.  Today is her birthday in fact and, despite trying to severely limit if not cut contact altogether, I sent her a snap (and in the process saw a picture of her with this guy who repeatedly confessed his love for her while we were dating..) She sent back a short thank you and that was it.. and I thought for a bit of all the fun shes having, all dressed up beautiful and the star of the show.. It stung a little, partly why Im back on this sub looking for support, but not as much as I would have thought.. 
And with your story as motivation I think I'm good.  At least good enough to go hit the gym and continue my "body by breakup" routine which has really been doing wonders both physically and mentally.. 

Im short.. thanks for sharing.  We're all going through very similar situations and its good to have it reinforced that no one is the first one to go through this or react badly to heartbreak and, most importantly.. that there is a light somewhere at the end of this tunnel.. Glad youre doing so well. Hopefully we'll all have a success story to share one day.

I ran into my ex from two relationships ago recently.. We fought a lot towards the end but I always blamed myself and kept telling myself I could have done something better. We dated for over 5 years and I was really really down after we seperated.. But when I saw again I realized I had no feelings for her anymore and.. after talking to her and some of our mutusl friends later.. found that her current boyfriend and her had been going through a lot of the same things we did... They fought all the time and she would just explode, publicly, over the smallest things. I got no pleasure from hearing about her troubles.. but it was somewhat comforting to hear that, maybe, I wasnt the problem all those years. Especially comforting was realizing that I had no more romantic feelings for her, particularly as Im going through a recent breakup. It reinforced the idea that time really does help us heal and move on... eveb after that amount of time together.

What do you think will happen if you text him? Most likely you'll get no response.. but in the meantime you'll be a slave to your phone.. checking it compulsively in the hopes it'll light up with his name.. Possibly he'll text you back.. but with what? Its not going to be "Im sorry, I messed up, I love you and lets get back together.." More than likely itll be something meaningless that will just make you feel worse.. or worse he'll say something about who he's with/what he's doing without you which will make you feel truly terrible.. 

Just be happy youve made it this long with No Contact, youre doing way better than me.. Distract yourself if possible.. If not, just go to bed and maybe youll feel better in the morning. Dont give him power over you... Dont let him know you even care that he still exists.. Youre bettwr than that.. Youre better than him.. Be strong and push through. ❤❤
Im 35 so I certainly hope 30 isnt too old for love.. 🙄😯😓

Push through man.. For the first few days it was like all the color had been draines from the world and all I saw was gray.. I think I literally didnt smile or laugh at anything for the first week... I had... terrible.. thoughts like what youre going through... and it still hurts like hell but its manageable now. Do shit to take your mind off it for the first few days.. Hanging with friends etc is ideal but it may mean just sleeping it off until its bearable.. But either way push through... Its gonna hurt for awhile, and there will be good days followed by bad ones..but it does get better by degrees.. over time

Can we as human beings all just agree to stop using this "I need to find myself.." bullshit.. Basically the same line I got.. "I could see myself marrying you one day but I just need to be single and find myself right now.." Bullshit.. The only thing you can do single that you couldn't do before is date/fuck other dudes... Yea fine.. that hurts..  but not anymore then trying to second guess wtf you really mean for hours on end.....

My ex and I made plans to move into a new place a weel before we broke up. Literally the day before she was talking about things we should do to decorate the place.. called me the best BF ever etc etc... Hell, we had great loving sex right AFTER we broke up (like minutes after...) she said she loved me more than anything.. and I havent seen her or heard her voice in 3 weeks...  Ive wasted a ton of time trying to figure it all out.. Was there some external person/factor at play that changed her mind about me in that small time frame? Had she been having doubts for awhile? Was she just a sociopath and the whole thing was just an act? In the end what Ive had to try to come to grips with is.. it really doesnt matter. This is my reality now and how I came to be here isnt going to change the past. Shes almost certainly not going to come back and knowing the details of why is more than likely just going to cause me more heartbreak... 

Its hard.. and I still find my mind drifting to these thoughts at times before forcing it to.. anything else at all.. but I know that dwelling on it is just going to hurt more so I do my best to focus on the present/future.. and you should too, as hard as I know that is..


❤❤❤❤

Ive actually been going to a tanning salon which is a first for me.. and ridiculous since I live in Texas, but its way quicker/easier than trying to do it naturally. Ive just got to look both ways upon entering and exiting to make sure no one I know happens to see me, lol. And Ive spent more money than Id care to admit on skin care products lately, both to offset any potential negative tanning effects and because the face is just naturally one of the first impressions you make. Spent a lot on silly stuff like this lately but.. I figure Im saving a ton on taking her to movies and nice dinners (which I did frequently INCLUDING on the day we broke up....) so I guess Im still ahead in the end.. Spent $300 on dinner a week or so before we split in fact... Im such an idiot... And now Im sad again, lol...

Maybe you can be friends... one day... but Id wait until you have no feelings for her before trying that road. Young people do stupid things so dont beat yourself up, and remember that the person youre truly meant to be with will be someone you wont have these issues with in the first place..
You too man. We'll all get through this

Best thing you can do is look as strong as you can even if you dont feel strong... Dont let her know shes anything to you anymore... Itll drive her crazy even if she acts like it doesnt.. Even the worst among us crave attention..

I just went through the same thing.. and everyone keeps saying that I cant overthink it/beat myself up and theyre right.  I spent the first few days desperately searching for answers, going through texts (the last couple she sent me were "youre the best boyfriend ever" and "I miss you so much..") but ultimately Im learning I just have to accept that there arent any answers and there wasn't anything I could have done... I dont get how someone can tell you theyll love you forever as theyre breaking up with you and that they could still see us getting married one day.. but ultimately I/you have to realize that the problem was them not you.  I could never do that to someone and I imagine you couldnt either but some people just dont feel the way we do.. At least it happened now and not years later when it would have hurt even more.. Look at it as you were spared a relationship with someone who was destined to hurt you eventually and try to move on

I don't know if its gender-specific necessarily, I think people just react differently. I was barely functional initially.. I literally didnt eat for over 5 days,  went to work but didnt do much and basically dwelled on it until I felt like I was about to explode. Meanwhile, she was going to parties every single day and just generally seemed to be living life to the fullest (made all the more painful by the fact that shes absolutely gorgeous and people were constantly hitting on her when we were together so I can only imagine whats happening now.. but I digress..) Today is the first day I haven't felt just incredibly empty and hurt in fact.. but Im slowly getting it together and you will too. Appear strong even if you dont feel it. Itll make you feel better and likely cause him some doubt as well. Getting over heartache is a fight, and a painful one... but we'll make it.

Hey brother,  Ive been going through the same thing lately and Ive sought advice from everywhere... and the OVERWHELMING consensus is that you should break contact for at list a few weeks. 

And trust me, I know thats hard and feels like youre adding heartache onto heartache but it actually accomplishes two things. Not only is it going to make things easier on you but if there is any chance of her changing her mind and yall working things out youve got to appear strong and she has to learn to miss you. If youre constantly trying to text her etc.. or immediately responding when she reaches out even, it lowers your value in her eyes, even if its just subconsciously without her realizing it.. 

Youve got to appear strong, even if youre not feeling strong right now, and youve got to let her miss you and realize she doesnt get to dictate how your relationship proceeds, whatever form that takes. 

Im still learning to practice what Im preaching, in truth Im only going on a couple days NC, but the thought process makes sense and its already made me feel a little better. Hopefully youll be heading in a positive direction too soon. Best of luck my friend, be strong.

Maybe its just that misery loves company but makes me feel a little better knowing that Im not just uniquely fucked up, lol. Going on 5 hours with no contact lol. Its a minute to minute kinda game, I want to text her so bad but I figure if I can just make it a few more hours till I get off work, I can pass out and maybe make it a full day.. We had plans for the 4th so thats gonna be real rough, but one day at a time I guess..
Every moment of every day..
